name: Banh A Choi
summary: Bánh A Chôi is a Bru–Vân Kiều dish Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park names with bánh A Dưh, Láp, and rượu cần. The park does not describe the batter.
origin: Bru–Vân Kiều communities in the Phong Nha-Ke Bang buffer.
culture: The park ties these dishes to community life, rites, and festivals in the heritage area.
howToEat: The park names the cake and does not say what it is made of or how it is eaten.
